name: Man Shall Not Lay With Man
overview: The Scriptures clearly define God's design for human relationships, affirming the union of man and woman as one flesh, as established in Genesis 2:24. Leviticus 18:22 and 20:13 explicitly prohibit a man lying with another man as with a woman, calling such actions an abomination with severe consequences. These commands reflect God's holiness and order in human sexuality, contrasting with other forbidden practices such as bestiality noted in Exodus 22:19 and improper familial relations outlined in Leviticus 18. Together, these passages underscore the biblical standard for sexual morality rooted in God's revealed will.
